title: Organization Credential Revocation Response v1
description: The answer of one POST /internal/v1/organization/credentials/revoke call. revoked counts the credentials revoked that the caller's workload binding did not mint; caller_revoked counts those it did, the calling credential among them. more is true while live credentials the binding did not mint remain; the caller then calls again, and the call that answers more false has revoked the binding's own credentials too.
